drugs.name: Lithium Carbonate
drugs.mechanism: Inhibits glycogen synthase kinase-3 beta (GSK3B) and inositol monophosphatase, stabilizing neuronal plasticity
drugs.efficacy: First-line gold standard for acute mania, maintenance therapy, and suicide prevention
drugs.adverse_effects: Tremor, polyuria, polydipsia, hypothyroidism, renal impairment with chronic exposure

drugs.name: Divalproex Sodium (Valproate)
drugs.mechanism: Enhances GABAergic neurotransmission, inhibits voltage-gated sodium channels, and modulates gene expression via HDAC inhibition
drugs.efficacy: Highly effective for acute manic episodes and mixed states
drugs.adverse_effects: Weight gain, alopecia, hepatotoxicity, thrombocytopenia, teratogenicity (neural tube defects)

drugs.name: Lamotrigine
drugs.mechanism: Voltage-gated sodium channel blocker inhibiting glutamate release in hyper-excitable cortical networks
drugs.efficacy: First-line maintenance therapy for preventing bipolar depressive relapse
drugs.adverse_effects: Dizziness, headache, diplopia, benign rash, rare Stevens-Johnson syndrome

drugs.name: Quetiapine
drugs.mechanism: Atypical antipsychotic and active norquetiapine metabolite with NET inhibition and 5-HT1A agonism
drugs.efficacy: Broad efficacy across bipolar depression, acute mania, and maintenance
drugs.adverse_effects: Somnolence, dry mouth, dizziness, constipation, metabolic syndrome
